job.job_description:
Node.js / Python (Flask, FastAPI, Falcon), MongoDB, MySQL, JavaScript, Redis, AWS

Responsibilities:

Develop robust, scalable backend systems using Node.js or Python frameworks (Flask, FastAPI, Falcon).
Design and optimize database schemas using MongoDB and MySQL .
Implement secure authentication, session management, caching (Redis), and APIs .
Write clean, efficient, and testable code following SDLC best practices .
Work with AWS services and CI/CD pipelines for deployment.
Collaborate directly with leadership to influence technical decisions and shape the product .

Requirements:

2+ years of hands-on experience in backend development.
Strong programming skills in Node.js or Python .
Solid understanding of API development, authentication, and caching techniques .
Experience with MongoDB, MySQL, and Redis .
Familiarity with AWS, Git, and CI/CD pipelines .
Knowledge of SDLC, testing methodologies, and debugging .
Startup mindset: Ownership, problem-solving, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Experience of working in React is a plus.

Perks:

Great Learning Opportunity: Work on multiple products from scratch.
Hands-on Product Development: Own end-to-end backend features.
Flexible Working Hours & a high-trust environment.
Fast Growth: Work directly with the CTO, CEO, and Product Manager .



This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
